response.text: {"title": "How we would deliver", "text": "We would deliver the solution by submitting the proposal as one document of no more than 15 pages sent by e-mail to the Trust's office by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12 [APP-001]. Email gateway reliability and hosting provider selection are assumptions [APP-001]. The system goes live by 2027-06-30, hosting and keeping all personal data exclusively within the United Kingdom [APP-001]. We would maintain a comprehensive record for each donor containing their contact details and complete gift history, recording their consent to be contacted by e-mail, post, and telephone, along with the specific date the consent was given [APP-002]. The underlying database architecture is an assumption [APP-002]. We would track and record the exact hours each volunteer contributes to each club and send an automated reminder two days before every session [APP-003]. The communication channel for reminders is an assumption [APP-003]. The system achieves 99% availability in each calendar month, and we would deliver comprehensive training to the Trust's staff before the system goes live [APP-004].
